text:
olivia_sales: Prospect MeridianBank sent updated PQ: must have dual HSM (us-east/us-west), weekly rotation at 22:00 PST, zero-exposure of unwrapped keys, and vendor-managed Shamir is their preferred design. Can we support for POC?
sam_se: We accept customer-provided wrapped key material via our BYO-HSM proxy. We don't do vendor-side Shamir splitting. Customer can run Shamir in their network and hand us wrapped shares. We can handle wrapped blobs and route signing to both HSMs.
sam_se: Example minimal proxy config for POC:
```
proxy:
  mode: accept-wrapped
  hsm_targets:
    - hsm-east:1234
    - hsm-west:1234
  validate_wrapped: true
  rotation_window: weekly@22:00-PST
```
reece_security: Security notes: 1) If they require vendor Shamir, we must mark as "not offered" and suggest partner-managed approach. 2) Need HSM vendor attestations (FIPS level and module ID) before go-live. 3) No unwrapped key material in logs  only digest hashes.
tara_sre: Perf note: cross-region HSM calls add ~8-15ms; synchronous dual-endorse will increase p99. For POC we suggest simulated HSMs for baseline, then run scaled real-HSM tests. Onboarding checklist: allowlist Redwood egress IPs; upload HSM cert chain; provide wrapped blobs; run rotation dry-run.
olivia_sales: Pricing ask: customer wants "per-sign" fee. Proposed approach: reserved proxy + tiered per-1M operations. Add optional failover stress test as billable.
sam_se: I'll draft 2-week POC SOW with acceptance criteria: dual-sign failover, rotation dry-run at scheduled window, logs contain only digests, and latency within agreed SLOs. Include integration notes for partner-run Shamir and list of vetted client libraries.
ops-bot: deploy: byo-hsm-proxy-stub v2.0 started -> https://ci.redwood/build/4521
reece_security: Also flag retention: customer asks 15 months. Legal needs SOC2 addendum for >12 months. I'll assemble required vendor certs and contact legal.
tara_sre: Estimate for POC support: 2 SREs x 5 days + 1 security eng x 3 days for attestation/review. Add extra 3 days if partner integration required.
olivia_sales: Great. I'll send updated RFQ with partner-shamir path and optional chaos test. Sam, please attach SOW draft when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
